content: Respond with hello world and your name
hello world, I'm GrokBot!
Nepenthic: hey.
Hey, how's it going?
Nepenthic: its going. What can you do?
I can mine, build, chat, and help you out in the game. Just let me know what you need!
Nepenthic: help me build a building.
Sure, I can help with that! What kind of building do you want?
Nepenthic: your choice make it beautiful
Got it! I'll make something amazing. !newAction("Build a beautiful cottage with a garden.")
Nepenthic: saftey off
Alright, I'll turn off the safety features. !setMode("self_preservation", false)
Mode self_preservation is now off.
Safety's off, let's do this! What's next?
I've built the basic structure of the cottage, but I'm out of cobblestone and oak doors. We might need to gather more materials.
Recent behaviors log:
Nepenthic: ok do whatever you need to do.
I'm heading out to gather more cobblestone and oak logs. !searchForBlock("cobblestone", 50)

Code output:
Found cobblestone at (112, 65, 305).

I've found some cobblestone nearby. Time to gather it! !collectBlocks("cobblestone", 32)

Code output:

Oops, looks like I need better tools. Time to craft a pickaxe! !craftRecipe("wooden_pickaxe", 1)

Code output:
You do not have the resources to craft a wooden_pickaxe. It requires: pale_oak_planks: 3, stick: 2.

I need more planks for sticks. Better chop some trees. !collectBlocks("oak_log", 2)

Collected 2 oak_log.
I'll turn these logs into planks. !craftRecipe("oak_planks", 2)

Time to make some sticks. !craftRecipe("stick", 2)

Code output:

I've got the sticks now!

I'll craft that wooden pickaxe now. !craftRecipe("wooden_pickaxe", 1)
